user.title: Private Core connection
user.description: Read-only development build. Choices and notifications are unavailable. Legacy credentials remain inactive. Changing Core URL invalidates cached context and cannot map choices across instances. Enter a new token; it is never prefilled.

reconfigure.title: Private Core connection
reconfigure.description: Read-only development build. Choices and notifications are unavailable. Legacy credentials remain inactive. Changing Core URL invalidates cached context and cannot map choices across instances. A blank replacement token keeps the current token only at the same Core origin. Changing scheme, hostname or effective port requires a new token.
